import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    L = np.log(1+eps)
    S = np.sqrt(T)
    z = p[0] + p[1]*S + p[2]*T + p[3]*T**2 + (p[4] + p[5]*T + p[6]*S + p[7]*T**2)*L + (p[8] + p[9]*T)*L**2 + (p[0]*0 + 0.0)*L**3 + 0.0*S
    return np.exp(z)
